all_refs: Exact {path,bytes,sha256}. No symlink data/source refs. Venv Python leaf alone may symlink to pinned python_realpath; executable still uses leaf path to retain venv.

containment.closure_truth: Owned process cannot claim its own physical closure. Both supervisor and outer leave all_owned_processes_closed=false. Independent Q must inspect every recorded identity and session after CLI exit.
containment.outer_launch: Root must launch run_cli_once.py as a unique session leader, e.g. setsid taskset -c 0,1 <pinnedPython> -I -B <run_cli_once.py> ...; attached shared PG/SID is rejected.
containment.supervisor: Popen start_new_session=true from outer. Supervisor PID=PGID=SID.
containment.uncertain_direct_Popen: If exact distinct supervisor identity is unavailable or invalid, close only owned unreaped Popen via TERM/KILL/reap, retain uncertainty, never signal guessed group or claim session closure; acceptance fails. Hard limit kills owned Popen if identity unvalidated.
containment.worker_and_native: Worker Popen start_new_session=false and all child native processes must inherit exact supervisor PG/SID.

fence_API: config.fence_source exact typed ref imported only after hash; module.verify_owner(config.owner) returns owner. No owner fallback.

score_metrics.actual_scored_case_ids: exact17 IDs only in scorer output, no mutation of raw worker forecast identities.
score_metrics.arms: count,correct,accuracy,Brier(mean sum3),NLL(mean stable unclipped log probability),confusion_matrix_gold_rows_prediction_columns,errors(classification rows),error_count,latency_seconds p50/p95/total/count,case_forward_participations,actual_pair_inferences,early_exit_count,full_context_count.

score_metrics.global_forward_accounting: True physical NLI calls are raw_worker.counters.NLI_forward_calls_completed, reconciled by unique raw NLI_batch_records batch_index and durable forward progress. Per-row actual_model_forward_calls means case-arm participation; summed participation is not physical calls.
